_comment: What 'vs prior period' means: the equal-length window immediately before [start, end], both ends inclusive. One rule, two languages: frontend/src/utils/dateWindow.test.ts holds previousWindow to these, and backend/tests/unit/test_previous_window.py holds domain.dates.previous_window to them. The Overview's server-side prior period was the month before the start whatever the range, while the Cash Flow Sankey's client-side one compared equal lengths, under the same label.

cases.note: a single day maps to the day before
month to date is not held against the whole prior month
